'''Mandalorian Nomad Armor''' was a type of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="Reveal" /> used around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Mandalorian-Nomad-Armor-Model.jpg|right|250px|thumb|Mandalorian Nomad Armor asset by Isaac Kellis.]]
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> armor set debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[March 28]], [[2023]], as part of a tie-in promotion for the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|''The Mandalorian'']],<ref name="Reveal" /> being directly inspired by [[Din Djarin]]'s [[Din Djarin's armor|armor]] featured heavily in the show.<ref name="The Mandalorian">''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''</ref> The set was modeled by character artist [[Isaac Kellis]].<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=isaackellis|url=artwork/w0xQ1V|name=[[Isaac Kellis]]|text=Star Wars: The Old Republic - Mandalorian Nomad outfit|date=2023-05-25|quote=Assets created for Star Wars: The Old Republic Star Wars © & TM 2023 Lucasfilm Ltd. All rights reserved}}</ref>
